fpv58_analog.label: 5.8 GHz analog FPV (video only)
fpv58_analog.notes: No control uplink. Wide rate ladder with low mac_eff => capacity falls smoothly with SNR (graceful degradation), ~3 ms latency.

ocusync.label: 5.8 GHz digital, DJI O3/O4-style
ocusync.notes: Very robust control MCS, ~30 ms glass-to-glass video.

wifi.label: 5.8 GHz digital, Walksnail/HDZero/OpenHD-style
wifi.notes: Wi-Fi-broadcast style link: no association, telemetry/RC passthrough.

elrs24.label: 2.4 GHz ISM control (ELRS-style, control only)
elrs24.notes: Crowded band: +4 dB ambient noise, burst losses.

lr12g.label: 1.2-1.3 GHz long-range digital (Microhard-class)
lr12g.notes: Narrow channel, good penetration and range.

cell.label: Cellular 4G LTE
cell.notes: Reused LTE template from uavlink_sim; serving-cell handover with A3/TTT.

nr_a.label: Cellular 5G NR (n78), single SIM
nr_a.notes: Higher path loss than LTE, lower latency.

sim_bond.label: Cellular 5G, multi-SIM bonding (N modems / operators)
sim_bond.notes: Expands into `sims` independent links (own fading/shadowing, alternate cells = operators): diversity + bonding.

leo.label: LEO satellite, Starlink-style (Ku, flat-panel)
leo.notes: Needs sky view (buildings obstruct), ~45 s cold acquisition => pre-warming matters, heavy and power hungry.

mesh_manet.label: Mesh / multi-hop RF (relay nodes along the corridor)
mesh_manet.notes: Relays on the ground along the corridor; route changes appear as handovers; capacity halves per hop (mac_eff 0.35).

fiber_tether.label: Fiber-optic tether (near-zero latency, jam-proof, range-limited)
fiber_tether.notes: Virtual anchor above home keeps the sim's obstruction model from blocking the cable; range limit is enforced by a pre-screen (mission must fit inside length_m) and a geofence at length_m; tether mass adds hover power.

walksnail.label: walksnail (walksnail_avatar)
walksnail.notes: Fast-mode approximation of drone_multilink radio family walksnail_avatar.

hdzero.label: hdzero (hdzero)
hdzero.notes: Fast-mode approximation of drone_multilink radio family hdzero.

crossfire868.label: crossfire868 (crossfire_868)
crossfire868.notes: Fast-mode approximation of drone_multilink radio family crossfire_868.

notes: pairwise: 12 of 136 2-subsets are not coverable under the constraints or were cut by max_combinations
